alert_number.description: Official EU Safety Gate alert notification number (e.g. A12/00001/26).

case_number.description: Case number of the alert notification.

publication_date.description: Date when the alert was published (YYYY-MM-DD).

risk_type.description: Types of risk (e.g., Chemical, Choking, Fire).

danger_description.description: Description of the hazard and danger.

notifying_country.description: EU member state submitting the alert.

country_of_origin.description: Country where the product was manufactured.

source_url.description: Link to the official EU Safety Gate notification page.

is_child_related.description: Whether the alert belongs to toys, baby products, or items intended for children.

child_age_group.description: Target age group: baby, toddler, child, or unknown.

child_hazards.description: Child-specific hazards identified: choking, chemical, magnets.

input_identifier.description: Original input identifier (EAN, ASIN, or Amazon URL) that matched this alert.

input_kind.description: Classification kind of the input identifier: gtin, isbn10, asin, or amazon_url.

resolution_method.description: Resolution method: direct_gtin, isbn10_conversion, csv_mapping, or url_slug_keywords.

match_confidence.description: Confidence level of match (e.g. 'keyword' for title slug matches).

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit from imported catalog CSV.

csv_row.description: Row number in the imported CSV file.
